speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Sclerosing Cholangitis (PSC).

The clinical picture of severe pruritus and abnormal liver function tests in a young male with known ulcerative colitis is highly suggestive of PSC. The negative viral and HIV serologies rule out common infectious etiologies. The abdominal ultrasound and colonoscopy reports I requested should confirm the characteristic "beading" of the bile ducts and the extent of colonic involvement.
